definition.name: Adaptive Rounded Mosaic
definition.description: Four-level adaptive monochrome mosaic built from aligned power-of-two rounded-square cells. Low-detail regions stay broad while edge/detail regions subdivide into smaller cells, preserving a cleaner portrait silhouette and avoiding overlapping grid scales. Cell tone is sampled once at each cell center so every tile remains solid; polarity-aware gaps create dark seams around light cells and light seams around dark cells. The Seed control introduces subtle deterministic threshold jitter so borderline regions break differently without disturbing the aligned tile hierarchy. Best on portraits, graphic imagery, and high-contrast photographs. Increase Detail Sensitivity for finer subdivision; use Seed for alternate cell distributions.

definition.name: Amiga Extra Half-Brite
definition.description: Amiga EHB-inspired source-image treatment. A fixed 32-register RGB12 palette uses eight hue families with four stepped RGB12 brightness tiers each; RGB12 components have 16 levels. The 6th-bitplane decision is independent from the 5-bit base register and shifts each 4-bit channel right by one (0xFFF becomes 0x777). Pixel Size selects centre-of-cell source samples; Dither Strength and Seed control deterministic pixel-grid dithering for tone and half-bright transitions; Exposure and Contrast shape palette selection; Neutral Range chooses colour versus neutral families. Halfbrite Cutoff and Enable Halfbrite affect only the half-bright bit, not the selected base register. Palette Temperature adjusts the red and blue register nibbles before the hardware-style half-bright shift. Effect Mix 100% keeps outputs in the fixed EHB palette (except alpha); partial blending introduces additional colours. Fixed-palette single-pass approximation, not a per-image palette optimizer, native bitplane format, or CRT simulation.
definition.author: ChromaMeld
